name: Yuri
source:
Magical girl. 
She saves Ayumu from being mugged by a delinquent, but when her magic fails and is laughed at, she gets angry and casts a spell on Ayumu to make him ejaculate uncontrollably as a punishment.
She is little anxious about her short stature, but despite her appearance, she is a bit of a sadist, and don't hesistate to tease Ayumu in a very sexual way.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=417865]Getchu[/url] and [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/感汁・魔汁・ぶっかけ性活]Wikipedia[/url]]
